g.text: One GeoDynamix export at algorithm grain: fbm -> M-Z maxima -> length threshold -> reconstruction -> file
G1 one step per chain device (outer boxes: generator, noise, mz_edges, hline_length, export)
G2 one step per device output (boxes inside mz_edges: "edges", "recon"), GeoDynamix's output_key grain
G3 one step per algorithm (every action box)
Arrow labels = the data that flows; each could be a hashed LE_Source.
generator [illustrative: GeoDynamix has no 2-D generator; xsmurf ibro steps unchecked]
dyadic M-Z transform + extrema2 edge detection
LastWave port, FIR convolutions bit for bit with convol2.c (no FFT)
keep line if min_len <= length <= max_len
output: recon (selects=True: its key folds in the selection recipe)
recon_levels table (own / near / coder per level),
(no GeoTIFF writer found in GeoDynamix yet:
recon reads TWO inputs: the mz_edges analysis result
and the hline_length keep masks. A per-device cut (G1)
hides that the filter sits between the two halves of mz_edges.
alpha_* as view=True (they do not re-key the transform),
yet they change the recon pixels: in a .prov they are
processing parameters. The .prov view section holds
object table (lines; per-line length, mod, alpha)
